description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Breya's Apprentice, adding {C}{C}.
When Breya's Apprentice dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Breya's Apprentice from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Breya's Apprentice enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
